movies.title: Metropolis
movies.description: Fritz Lang's 1927 science-fiction film about a divided city, from a script by Thea von Harbou. Playback is the Internet Archive player for an item with a Public Domain Mark and English titles.

movies.title: Big Buck Bunny

movies.note: The Foundation's direct download host refused this network with HTTP 403, so playback uses the Internet Archive copy of the same CC BY 3.0 release. Credit the Blender Foundation, www.bigbuckbunny.org. Rights-holder page: https://peach.blender.org/about/

sources.qualityNote: Internet Archive's own player for this item.

review.reviewNotes: Manual review on 2026-11-23. Cartoon slapstick of about 10 minutes. A butterfly is harmed and the rabbit retaliates. No dialogue. Approved for ages 6 and up and for family viewing. Not published for preschool.
